title: Transformer-Encoder Trees for Efficient Multilingual Machine Translation and Speech Translation
abstract: arXiv:2509.17930v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multilingual translation suffers from computational redundancy, especially when translating into multiple languages simultaneously. In addition, translation quality can suffer for low-resource languages. To address this, we introduce Transformer Encoder Tree (TET), a hierarchical, non-autoregressive encoder-only architecture trained with Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) for multilingual translation. TET shares intermediate representations among linguistically similar target languages, improving accuracy on low-resource languages while reducing computational redundancy and enabling the generation of all target languages in a single forward pass. TET eliminates the sequential bottleneck of autoregressive models and supports fully parallel decoding of all tokens across all target languages. Compared to a naive one-to-many multilingual design, TET reduces the total parameter count by 66% and lowers inference computation

translated_title: 用于高效多语言机器翻译与语音翻译的Transformer编码器树
translated_abstract: 多语言翻译存在计算冗余问题，尤其是在同时翻译成多种语言时。此外，低资源语言的翻译质量也可能受到影响。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了Transformer编码器树，这是一种分层的、非自回归的纯编码器架构，使用连接主义时序分类（CTC）进行训练，用于多语言翻译。TET在语言学上相近的目标语言之间共享中间表示，从而提高低资源语言的翻译准确率，同时减少计算冗余，并能在单次前向传播中生成所有目标语言。TET消除了自回归模型的顺序瓶颈，支持对所有目标语言的所有token进行完全并行解码。与朴素的“一对多”多语言设计相比，TET将总参数量减少了66%，并降低了推理计算量。
tldr: 提出分层非自回归的Transformer编码器树（TET），通过在相近语言间共享中间表示，实现单次前向传播并行生成所有目标语言，参数量减少66%并显著降低推理计算，同时提升低资源语言翻译质量。
